no_adcom_quote.quote: The Advisory Committee Meeting was cancelled, on the grounds that the Committee members would not have the full information necessary to support their positions, and the Major Amendment delayed the PDUFA goal date from September 27, 2019 to December 27, 2019.

summary: An Advisory Committee Meeting was originally scheduled for July 31, 2019 to obtain outside expertise on long-term safety concerns arising from the two-year nonclinical carcinogenicity study, but it was never held. At the July 18, 2019 Late Cycle Meeting the Division and Applicant agreed the Applicant would file a Major Amendment providing additional nonclinical studies and analyses, and the Division cancelled the AdComm on the grounds that committee members would not have the full information needed. Because no committee was convened and no vote occurred, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
